rationale: WGA 2027 Graduate Civil / Traffic Engineer program in Southbank, Melbourne, for recent graduates in civil or related disciplines, starting February 2027.

Melbourne location suits Melton; WGA is a consultancy so drawing review and documentation skills transfer.
